notes.title: Toilet Chronicles Steam Trading Cards are live!
notes.notes:
Hey partners! 

If you've played Toilet Chronicles, you are now eligible to receive Steam trading cards.

There are 5 cards to collect. Getting them all will allow you to craft a tentacle-toilet badge for your profile. On top of that you will receive toilet themed emojis and profile backgrounds, one of it being a Toilet Tentacle!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42313081/4c7662ae9fdda9fd4f8711f0076e2b313bbcaf2e.jpg[/img]

To collect cards and craft a badge, simply play the game. Up to half of the entire card set is dropped that way and they drop at random intervals. For the rest of the cards you will have to put your trading skills to some good use. Once you have a full set of cards, you craft them into a badge and get rewarded with random emojis and backgrounds.

Happy Trading!

notes.title: Toilet Chronicles: Staff Only DLC is OUT!

[h1]DLC Toilet Chronicles: Staff Only[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2202610/Toilet_Chronicles_Staff_Only/?curator_clanid=42313081

[h2]Why play [DLC]?[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 new locations
[*] 4 new endings
[*] 2 new hidden ahievements
[*] Even more bugs added [give me a break, I'll fix them]
[*] Some plot questions from the main story explained
[/list]

[h2]How to activate DLC in-game?[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Leave the first bathroom
[*] Find the "Staff Only" door
[i][if you don't own the DLC the game will offer you to go to the DLC's store page][/i]
[*] Enter the staff room
[i]All the contents of the DLC are in that room[/i]
[/olist]
